KRISHN KUMAR SHUKLA

Project Manager · Program Manager · Payments Technology Leader · CPM / FPM Practitioner . Agile/SAFe · Jira, KANBAN & Confluence Expert

✉ krish150187@gmail.com | ☏ +91 98449 93457 | 🔗 https://www.linkedin.com/in/krishna-shukla-34b632103 | 📍 Indore, MP, India · Open to Remote, Hybrid & Global Roles

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Project / Program Manager and Payments Technology Leader with 16+ years of global delivery experience across Tier- 1 banks in the UK, Australia, US, and India. Deep domain expertise in Critical Path Method (CPM), Financial Performance Management (FPM), enterprise payments infrastructure (RTP, NPP, ACH, Fedwire, FPS, CHAPS, SEPA, SWIFT, ISO 20022), and AML/regulatory compliance. Consistently drives measurable outcomes — 30% faster incident resolution, 40% operational efficiency gains, and zero compliance breaches — through Agile/SAFe delivery, CI/CD modernization, and enterprise observability platforms. Hands-on experience with Agile methods, Waterfall delivery, and hybrid models; advanced expertise in Jira and Confluence for governance, reporting, and collaboration. Certified Agile Scrum Master; PMP in progress.

CORE COMPETENCIES & TECHNICAL KEYWORDS

▪ Program & Project Mgmt: CPM (Critical Path Method), FPM (Financial Performance Management), PMP, Agile, SAFe, Scrum, Kanban, WBS, EVM (Earned Value Management), RAID Logs, Stakeholder Management, Delivery Governance, Risk & Issue Management, Budgeting & Forecasting, SDLC, Change Management, ITIL, Release Management, Resource Planning, Waterfall Delivery

▪ Payments & Banking: Real-Time Payments (RTP), NPP, ACH, Fedwire, FPS, CHAPS, SEPA, SWIFT, STP, AML, CATM, FX Payments, ISO

20022, PSD2, Payment Modernization, Regulatory Compliance, APRA, FCA, Basel III

▪ Monitoring & Observability: Splunk, AppDynamics, Axway Decision Insight, Observe, Business Bridge, ServiceNow (SNOW), KPI

Dashboards, Incident Management, SLA/SLO/SLI Governance, Alerting Frameworks

▪ Technology & Engineering: Java, Spring Boot, SQL, DB2, MQ, Microservices, REST APIs, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, JFrog, Snyk CLI, CI/CD

Pipelines, DevSecOps, Shift-Left Testing

▪ Tools & Platforms: Jira (10+ years), Confluence (10+ years), GitHub, MS Project, ServiceNow, IntelliJ, VS Code, PowerBI ▪ Leadership & Emerging: Global Distributed Teams, Executive Reporting, P&L Awareness, Portfolio Management, AI-assisted

Automation, Generative AI Tooling, Observability-as-Code, Data-Driven Decision Making

▪ Methodologies: Agile, SAFe, Scrum, Waterfall, Hybrid Delivery

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) Senior Payments Technology Lead & Project Manager Spearheading payments monitoring modernization programs for NPP, CBIS, POM, CLML, and PVSL platforms across Australia's largest bank. Budget accountability: AUD 2M+ program portfolio. ▪ Applied Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling and Earned Value Management (EVM) to manage program timelines, track SPI/CPI

Mar 2021 – Present Bangalore / Remote (India)

variances, and deliver AUD 2M+ portfolio on schedule and within budget across NPP, CBIS, POM, CLML, and PVSL programs.

▪ Directed Financial Performance Management (FPM) reporting — monthly budget reviews, cost forecasting, and variance analysis — for

senior leadership and CBA executive stakeholders.

▪ Reduced incident resolution time by 30% through enterprise Splunk dashboard design, AppDynamics alerting, and real-time

observability frameworks adopted by 200+ operations staff across India, UK, and Australia.

▪ Spearheaded Spring-to-Spring Boot modernization and CI/CD pipeline adoption (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, JFrog), cutting deployment

cycle time by 25% and improving release reliability by eliminating manual release gates.

▪ Facilitated Agile/SAFe ceremonies — PI Planning, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives — for cross-functional squads of

15–20 engineers across three time zones.

▪ Built and maintained RAID logs, program risk registers, and APRA/AML/CTF compliance tracking dashboards aligned to CBA's regulatory

obligations.

▪ Excelled in Agile methods and hybrid delivery; leveraged Jira and Confluence extensively for sprint planning, backlog grooming,

▪

governance reporting, and stakeholder transparency. Introduced Snyk CLI into the DevSecOps pipeline, achieving shift-left security scanning and reducing critical vulnerabilities prior to production deployment.

▪ Leveraged AI-assisted anomaly detection and generative AI tools to enhance monitoring intelligence, reducing alert fatigue by ~20% and

accelerating root-cause analysis.

Infosys Ltd Technology Lead & Project Manager Clients: RBS · Bank of America Enterprise payments monitoring & AML compliance delivery for RBS, one of the UK's largest retail and commercial banks (FCA-regulated). ▪ Delivered enterprise FPS (Faster Payments Service), CHAPS, SEPA, and AML monitoring solutions — achieving zero compliance breaches

Sep 2019 – Mar 2021 Pune / Remote (India)

across two consecutive FCA audit cycles.

▪ Applied CPM-based project scheduling to map critical dependencies across SIT, UAT, and production rollout phases; proactively flagged

and resolved blockers 2+ weeks ahead of milestones.

▪ Managed full project delivery lifecycle: scope definition, WBS creation, effort estimation, resource planning, and governance reporting

for offshore teams of 10+ engineers.

▪ Coordinated with UK architects, FCA compliance officers, and operations leadership to translate regulatory requirements into technical

delivery plans and change management processes.

▪ Produced executive-level stakeholder status reports, escalation packs, and risk dashboards that increased transparency across

onshore/offshore delivery model.

▪ Applied Agile methods and Waterfall delivery models depending on project context; used Jira and Confluence for backlog

management, sprint tracking, and compliance documentation.

Cognizant Technology Solutions Senior Associate & Technical Lead Clients: JP Morgan Chase · Lloyds Banking Group · T-Mobile Germany 10 years of progressive technical leadership across global Tier-1 banking, fintech, and telecom clients — managing delivery, automation, and compliance platforms. ▪ Led automation and monitoring dashboard programs for JP Morgan Chase (ACH/Fedwire) and Lloyds Banking Group (FPS/BACS),

Oct 2009 – Sep 2019 Pune (India)

reducing manual effort by 40% and improving MTTD on payment failures.

▪ Built KPI and financial performance dashboards supporting executive-level FPM reporting; improved compliance reporting accuracy by

35% and directly supported regulatory audit cycles.

▪ Managed end-to-end SDLC — requirements, development, SIT, UAT, production deployment — in FCA, SEC, and Basel III regulated

banking environments.

▪ Delivered ITIL-aligned change management, release governance, and incident escalation processes for global teams across the US, UK,

India, and Germany.

▪ Mentored and coached junior engineers and BAs; reduced team onboarding time by 30% through structured knowledge transfer and

delivery playbooks.

▪ Managed project financials, resource utilization tracking, and effort forecasting — contributing to P&L accountability across multi-

million-dollar client engagements.

▪ Extensive Waterfall delivery experience in early career; later transitioned to Agile/SAFe frameworks. Jira and Confluence used for

workflow management, reporting, and collaboration across distributed teams.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS & QUANTIFIED IMPACT

▪ 30% reduction in incident resolution time at CBA — enterprise Splunk & AppDynamics observability overhaul. ▪ 40% operational efficiency gain — end-to-end automation across JP Morgan Chase (ACH/Fedwire) and Lloyds Banking Group (FPS/BACS). ▪ Zero FCA compliance breaches across two consecutive RBS UK audit cycles via rigorous payments monitoring governance. ▪ AUD 2M+ program portfolio managed on schedule and within budget at CBA using CPM scheduling and EVM tracking. ▪ 4 Tier-1 global banks served: CBA, RBS, Lloyds Banking Group, JP Morgan Chase — payments monitoring platforms delivered.

▪ 25% faster deployment cycles through Spring Boot modernization and CI/CD pipeline adoption at CBA. ▪ 16+ years of zero major production incidents attributed to direct oversight — high-availability payment system delivery. ▪ Proven success blending Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models; advanced Jira/Confluence expertise supporting governance

and collaboration.

CERTIFICATIONS

▪ Project Management Professional (PMP) — PMI In Progress — Expected May 2026 ▪ Agile Scrum Master — Simplilearn 2026 ▪ Claude 101 (Generative AI & Prompt Engineering) — Anthropic 2026 ▪ Senior Payments Technology Lead & Project Manager — Micro1 2024

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Engineering — Mechanical Engineering | First Division Rajiv Gandhi Technical University, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India · 2004 – 2008

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

▪ Global Delivery Experience: United Kingdom · Australia · United States · Germany · India (cross-border, multi-timezone) ▪ Industry Domains: Retail Banking · Investment Banking · Payments & Fintech · Telecommunications · Logistics ▪ Methodologies: CPM · FPM · EVM · Agile · SAFe · Scrum · ITIL · PRINCE2-aware · Waterfall · Hybrid Delivery ▪ Languages: English (Professional Proficiency) · Hindi (Native) ▪ Work Authorization: Indian Citizen · Open to relocation & visa sponsorship — UK, Australia, UAE, USA, Singapore
